mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS over 3 months signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in a month, S&P 500 forward returns turn negative over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE exceeding 0.2pp threshold, or returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in GDPC1 above its 5-week moving average predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year window, or 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDPC1 and HOUST above their 5-week moving averages triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST above 5-week MA
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies exceed MA (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year window, or returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS exceeds 1.5 million in a month, S&P 500 forward returns turn positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain negative despite PAYEMS exceeding threshold, or returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in FEDFUNDS coupled with an increase in UNRATE above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening and labor market stress
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative when both conditions met (t-test p >0.05), or returns positive despite trigger.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (characterized by consecutive monthly GDPC1 growth exceeding 2% and INDPRO growth exceeding 1%), sustained high GDPC1 growth predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth >2% AND INDPRO growth >1% in last month
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies meet growth thresholds (t-test p >0.05), or regime conditions not sustained.
